title: The glucose readings aren't added in 5 minute intervals anymore
symptom: Glucose readings on the xDrip graph are not spaced evenly at 5-minute intervals; intervals vary from 2 to 8 minutes, making the dots unevenly spaced, though the data table and logs show correct 5-minute timestamps.
cause: The FUZZER constant (2.5 minutes) used to place readings on a grid causes time shifts when the fractional part of the division is near 0 or 1, leading to occasional 2.5-minute shifts in graph display.
fix: Update to xDrip release 2022.08.18 or later, which is supposed to fix the issue. Alternatively, lower the fuzzer to 37.5 seconds in engineering mode via advanced display settings.
evidence_quote: This is supposed to have been fixed with August 18, 2022. https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2022.08.18 Please update to that release or any after that, and please report if you ever still experience the reported issue.
